id.description: A unique ID for the Firewall Rule.

action.description:
Action to take when this rule is met.

* accept

protocol.description:
The protocol for this rule.

* ICMP
* TCP
* UDP
* GRE

port.description: Port or port range for this rule.

subnet.description: The IPv4 network in CIDR notation. Example: 192.0.2.123

subnet_size.description: The number of bits for the netmask in CIDR notation. Example: 24

source.description:
If the source string is given a value of "cloudflare" subnet and subnet_size will both be ignored.
Possible values:

|   | Value | Description |
| - | ------ | ------------- |
|   | "" | Use the value from `subnet` and `subnet_size`. |
|   | cloudflare | Allow all of Cloudflare's IP space through the firewall |

ip_type.description:
The type of IP rule.

* v4
* v6
